alternates.summary: The Atlantic CEO Nicholas Thompson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that AI offers powerful tools for businesses but poses significant risks to media, while its broader economic impact continues to lag behind rapidly advancing capabilities. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Thompson also discusses the discipline of distance running and how the sport shaped his relationship with his father and became an organizing force in his life. (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: AI Boom Faces a Growing Public Backlash

The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label in the same format as […]
articles.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

articles.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Gideon Lewis-Kraus explains how advanced chipmaking depends on a deeply interconnected global network of specialized companies, including ASML and TSMC, making semiconductor supply chains extraordinarily difficult to replicate or relocate. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lewis-Kraus describes the remarkable engineering behind ASML’s EUV machines and why rebuilding a semiconductor ecosystem in the US is a generational project rather than a simple exercise in reshoring. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Making Advanced MicroChips Takes a Global Ecosystem
